snippet.title: Ashen Throne Alpha Gameplay First Look
snippet.description:
Ashen Throne is a post-apocalyptic strategy MMO that combines alliance warfare like Rise of Kingdoms and Lords Mobile with the extraction-shooter tension of Arc Raiders. Build a mobile Crawler base on the Frontier. Push into the fog-shrouded Wastes for rare loot. Coordinate alliance sieges on the Citadel.

In this alpha footage:
• Mobile crawler base — your home drives across the map in real time
• Extraction PvP — raid ruins for loot, but you're exposed the second you drop shields
• Citadel siege — alliance-vs-alliance battles for the last city standing
• Battle replay — every fight plays out as a full animated replay you can scrub, built on a Kinetic / Electric / Psionic counter triangle with commander skills and formations

Currently in closed alpha.
→ Request access: https://discord.com/invite/jFzuudb8Aa

Feedback, questions, and alliance recruiting welcome in the comments.
